hooks.name: Confirm Infra Changes
hooks.description: Prompts for confirmation before any write that targets infra/ (CDK/CloudFormation), since infra changes have a broad blast radius. Non-infra writes pass through untouched.

action.command: INPUT=$(cat); TARGET=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | grep -oE '"(path|targetFile)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)"/\1/'); case "$TARGET" in */infra/*|infra/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This write targets infra/ (CDK/CloudFormation). Infra changes have a broad blast radius; confirm before proceeding."}}';; *) : ;; esac; exit 0
